scope: Current active manuscript claims. Archived published summaries and predictions audited; sealed raw holdouts not reopened; no training or inference.

claims.claim: Fresh holdout: 151/176 eligible joint compositions (85.8%) are missed when both component edits preserve the oracle label and both component predictions are correct.
claims.allowed_wording: On the one-shot fresh holdout, 151/176 (85.8%) oracle-changing compositions were missed, conditional on both component edits being oracle-label preserving and correctly predicted.
claims.forbidden_wording: Do not imply 176 independent parents, omit atomic preconditions, or pool discovery 62/66 with the fresh result.
claims.denominator: Archived n04_clean aggregate: 176 eligible cases, 151 misses. Discovery 62/66 is separate; matched-single control 61%/251 is descriptive.

recomputation.kind: Archived-summary arithmetic and eligibility-code audit; no raw holdout or inference.

claims.limitations: The published aggregate does not expose unique-parent count or parent-cluster uncertainty for the 176 cases. The one-shot holdout remains sealed.
claims.fixes: No numeric correction required. State eligibility conditions and keep discovery/fresh denominators separate.

claims.claim: P1 reports current-state error and post-flip endpoint error by frozen pre-change confidence bins, plus grouped OOF predictive associations.
claims.allowed_wording: Among currently correct examples undergoing a true semantic flip, endpoint error rises across bins of pre-change confidence. Grouped OOF results support predictive association, not causality.
claims.forbidden_wording: Do not call start confidence endpoint confidence, treat bins as equal-sized quartiles, or generalize conditional flip results to deployment prevalence or causality.
claims.denominator: Six models by two banks. Archived ranges: current error lowest bin 0.2733–0.5105 and highest bin 0.0183–0.0571; flip endpoint error lowest bin 0.3632–0.6086 and highest bin 0.9477–1.0. Of 12 top-bin estimates, 11 are 1.0 and one is 0.9831.

recomputation.kind: Archived prediction-summary consistency audit; no model inference.
checks: Audited start_correct agreed with start prediction/label and end_correct with end prediction/label.
Confirm thresholds match frozen dev thresholds.
P1G_CORRECTED is the active corrected artifact; stale P1G is superseded.

claims.limitations: Cutoffs are frozen dev thresholds and tied observations make bin counts unequal. Flip results condition on a correct start and true semantic change.
claims.fixes: Identify confidence as pre-change/start confidence and retain conditional wording.

claims.claim: P2 evaluates a refusal/coverage operating point and bounded affine-logit controls.
claims.allowed_wording: Among 93 oracle-feasible scenes in the 171-scene test slice, refusal fell 0.4301 to 0.1183 and coverage rose 0.5699 to 0.8817; non-refusal precision was similar (0.2264 vs 0.2195). The tested bounded affine control did not reproduce the full repair profile.
claims.forbidden_wording: Do not use 171 as refusal-rate denominator, claim universal precision gains, or generalize beyond the tested affine grid and operating point.
claims.denominator: U02: 93 feasible of 171 test scenes; rates use feasible scenes. P2 affine analysis: 43 feasible dev and 96 feasible eval scenes.

recomputation.kind: Published aggregate arithmetic and archived-summary audit; no inference.

claims.limitations: U02 is a single seeded split from a reused pool. Affine search is bounded to registered grid and selected seeds; several intervals include zero.
claims.fixes: Keep 93/171 feasibility adjacent to rates and scope affine wording to evaluated grid.

claims.claim: P3 decomposes endpoint repair into full repair and migration among clean-baseline hard cases; U1 and fresh own-conditional summaries use distinct denominators.
claims.allowed_wording: Among clean-baseline hard cases, endpoint repair partitions into full repair plus migration. Migration accounts for about 79–94% of endpoint repair in audited dev summaries. Parent-cluster intervals resample parents and retain associated quartets, while point estimates remain quartet-row weighted.
claims.forbidden_wording: Do not report conditional rates as global repair fractions or equal-parent point estimates. Do not treat fresh 109/141 as a paired delta against 151/176.
claims.denominator: P3 H sizes are 110, 120, 110 for seeds 11, 23, 47. U1 H sizes are 110, 120, 110 with 58, 65, 56 parents. Fresh flipmine is 109/141.

recomputation.kind: Archived P3/U1/confirmation summaries and per-quartet table recalculation; no sealed raw inputs opened.

claims.limitations: Parent-cluster bootstrap does not convert the row-weighted point estimator to an equal-parent estimand. Confirmation values are published aggregate checks only.
claims.fixes: Current reproducibility text distinguishes cluster-resampled intervals from quartet-level point estimates. Keep baseline conditioning explicit.

claims.claim: Six archived WP4 arms show stronger static-error/action-invalidity association than transition-error/action-invalidity association; present Spearman code handles ties and non-finite pairs.
claims.allowed_wording: Across six archived arms, static error correlates with action invalidity at rho 0.94 versus rho 0.54 for transition error, as a one-seed arm-level association.
claims.forbidden_wording: Do not call this multi-seed or causal evidence or generalize beyond six archived arms.
claims.denominator: Six arms, one seed. Archived vectors have six distinct finite values; the correction does not change reported values.

recomputation.kind: Archived six-arm rank-correlation recalculation under ordinal and average-rank methods; identical because saved vectors contain no ties.

claims.limitations: No WP4 inference or artifact rewrite was performed. Six arms from one seed only.
claims.fixes: Minimal present-code fix uses average ranks, pairwise finite filtering, and no coefficient for constant or underspecified inputs.

not_run: No training, download, rental, external transmission, or inference.
Sealed raw holdout_909, confirm_1007, holdout_895, J03WQQ, and SoccerTrack-v2 inputs were not reopened.
No broad test suite. The targeted Spearman regression test was previously run: 6 passed.
